definitions.gloss: entry into the water; the moment of entering the water
definitions.explanation: In diving and swimming, the act or moment of entering the water. In diving, a clean, near-splashless entry is a mark of good technique. Read にゅうすい; also used with する.

examples.japanese: ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|にゅう}{水|すい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}み→飛び込み：07114_tobikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入|にゅう}{水|すい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In diving, the beauty of the entry into the water is scored.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}しぶき→水しぶき：20240_mizushibuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧{入|にゅう}{水|すい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高得点|こうとくてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながった。
examples.english: An entry that kept the splash down led to a high score.

notes:
A swimming and diving term for entering the water. Read にゅうすい here; the same characters read じゅすい refer to drowning oneself, an unrelated word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入|にゅう}{水|すい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enter the water
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{入|にゅう}{水|すい}: a clean entry
- {入|にゅう}{水|すい}⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧: angle of entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}み→飛び込み：07114_tobikomi⟧: diving — the sport/act of jumping in; {入|にゅう}{水|すい} is specifically the entry moment
